title: I've spent 3 weeks rebuilding Budapest for my indie car combat game, BRUTAL DERBY. I think it was worth it.
author: Dense-Bar-2341
selftext:
I've been working on the Budapest track for the past 3 weeks, and I'm finally happy with how it looks, especially at night.

The track covers part of the Danube, Liberty Bridge, Elisabeth Bridge, Hotel Gellért, and the surrounding streets. I've also added trams, buses, boats, traffic, and plenty of smaller details to make the city feel alive.

This wasn't something I could build with a few AI prompts. I had to rebuild the road network using my own spline tools, manually fix intersections, place buildings, and go through countless optimization passes.

Some other improvements I've made recently:

\- Increased the crowds from 300 to over 3,000 spectators.

\- Added thousands of GPU-driven lights with volumetric effects in Unity URP.

\- Improved the AI drivers so they can anticipate upcoming corners.

\- Improved vehicle combat, tire wear, and destruction effects.

\- Fixed a lot of bugs and optimized performance.

\- Added a new industrial demolition derby arena.

The game currently has 8 derby arenas, 4 racing tracks, different weather conditions, day/night variations, and local 2-player co-op. Online multiplayer and story mode are planned.

I'm a longtime full-stack developer and an indie game developer, building this project solo. I use AI where it makes sense, but there's still a huge amount of manual work involved.

And getting all this to run reasonably well on an RTX 3070 has been another challenge.

Anyway, here are some new screenshots and gameplay footage. Curious what you think, especially about nighttime Budapest.
